title: Enuma Elish

claimed_setting.text: Before heaven and earth are named.
claimed_setting.label: PRIMARY SOURCE

translations.note: Comparison cells are summaries, not continuous translations. Check each linked source and passage.

primordial-state.text: Apsu and Tiamat mingle their waters before the naming of heaven and earth.
primordial-state.label: PRIMARY SOURCE

first-actors.text: Apsu and Tiamat; subsequent generations include Lahmu, Lahamu, Anshar and Kishar.
first-actors.label: PRIMARY SOURCE

creation-order.text: Marduk splits Tiamat’s body and makes a sky-roof from one half, containing her waters.
creation-order.label: PRIMARY SOURCE

human-creation.text: Humanity is made from Qingu’s blood to perform the gods’ work. Ea carries out the creation.
human-creation.label: PRIMARY SOURCE

divine-structure.text: The gods assemble and establish Marduk’s authority.
divine-structure.label: PRIMARY SOURCE

knowledge-mortality.text: Ea discovers the plot against the younger gods.
knowledge-mortality.label: PRIMARY SOURCE
